why_this_file_exists: coding-task.json originally recorded only the model NAME. The registry then served a different build under the same tag, and nothing on disk could say which build had been measured. These are the facts about the earlier build, preserved before they were lost.

old_build.id_source: `ollama list` ID column, read on 2026-10-07 immediately before the model was removed

registry_probe_2026-10-01.file: probe_manifests.py output, cloud-manifest.json as of 1 Oct

old_build.ollama_version_at_benchmark: 0.34.2 or 0.35.0 (the updater changed it mid-session and the file did not record it)
old_build.recoverable_note: Only a 12-character prefix survives. The tag no longer serves this build.

cause_of_behaviour_change: UNKNOWN. Both the weights (digest) and the Ollama runner version changed between the two runs; they cannot be separated. Do not claim either as the cause.
